title: KYLE §3 hue targets shipped as 'optional swap' comments, not pre-filled SPEC defaults; §3 blur-test cure deferred
evidence:
tools/gen_sprites.py:72-76:
HOUSE_COLORS    = ["#E85A4A", "#F2C94C", "#5ECB6B", "#4A9BE2"]  # coral/gold/sage/sky
HOST_FILL       = "#3E78D0"    # deep blue (KYLE: #4682B4)
DC_FILL         = "#4E8AA0"    # teal (unwired)
SMALL_BIZ_FILL  = "#9C8C6C"    # warm stone (KYLE: #A0937D)
CAMPUS_FILL     = "#A8503C"    # brick (KYLE: #8B4513)

docs/silhouette-spec.md:59: "- **Fill:** warm-stone `#9C8C6C` (KYLE §3 hue target `#A0937D` — optional swap;"

kyle-design-directions.md §3: "- Proposed Direction: Small_biz → cool-stone (#A0937D), campus → brick (#8B4513), residential → warm-terracotta (#CD5C5C), content_host → deep-blue (#4682B4). Blur-test cure: ≥15° hue separation, sat band ≤0.3."

Briefing names this as source of truth: "source of truth: kyle-design-directions.md §3 silhouettes".
detail: The briefing names kyle §3 as source of truth, but its proposed hues (and the ≥15° blur-test cure) ship only as optional-swap annotations; a user launching Blender against the pre-filled defaults lands canon hues, not §3 targets.
recommended_fix: Either pre-fill the §3 hexes as SPEC defaults, or add the §3 blur-test hue-separation check as an explicit merge-gate item for the node-clarity fold-in.
